# South Valley Children's Dentistry and Orthodontics

> A comprehensive pediatric dental and orthodontic practice in Albuquerque, New Mexico, specializing in preventative care, restorative procedures, and specialized treatment for children with special needs.

South Valley Children's Dentistry and Orthodontics serves children ages 1-18 with a full range of dental services including pediatric dentistry, orthodontics (braces and Invisalign), oral surgery, and sedation dentistry. The practice welcomes Medicaid patients and offers multiple payment and financing options.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Invisalign
- Special Needs Dentistry
- Sedation Dentistry
- Preventative Care
- Fluoride Treatments
- Medicaid Coverage
- Oral Surgery
- Digital X-Rays
- Restorative Procedures
- Albuquerque
- Appointment Scheduling
- Insurance Accepted
- Child Dental Care

## Core Services

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.southvalleychildrensdentistry.com/kid-dentistry): Pediatric dentistry services for ages 1-18 with preventative and restorative care
- [Orthodontics](https://www.southvalleychildrensdentistry.com/orthodontics): Orthodontic treatment options including braces, aligners, and Invisalign
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://www.southvalleychildrensdentistry.com/special-needs-dentistry): Specialized dental care for children with developmental disabilities and special needs
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://www.southvalleychildrensdentistry.com/special-needs-dentistry/sedation-dentistry): Sedation dentistry options for anxious children and special needs patients
- [Oral Surgery](https://www.southvalleychildrensdentistry.com/oral-surgery): Oral surgery services including wisdom teeth extraction and orthodontic exposures
